strategy: single-pass, impact-gated adversarial audit (Frax bar: demonstrated theft-of-funds or permanent-freezing vs CURRENT LIVE deployments, fork PoC required). Domain Hunters in risk order, then Skeptic, then Referee per domain with surviving candidates.

target.scopeNote: src/contracts only for findings. Tests, scripts, specification/, flattened.sol, docs are context/evidence only. lib/ vendored code excluded.

D.name: Access control / privileged roles + FRAX-frxUSD boundary
D.note: Role-misuse findings whose flawed code lives in another domain's file must be relayed to the coordinator for dedup/reassignment, not reported under D.

notes: Single-pass default. Coverage: all 10 src/contracts/*.sol files + utils + Constants assigned across 4 domains; interfaces context-only.
Frax bar gates every claim: only theft-of-funds / permanent-freezing vs live deployments with fork PoC. Sub-bar observations go to nonqualifying-{A,B,C,D}.md, never inflated.
Exclusion list (Phase 0A) is authoritative: ToB Oct 2023 + ChainSecurity Jul 2025 findings must not be re-reported.
Live-state gating: a source-level defect in a contract with no live deployment, or in dead code paths, is sub-bar unless a live instance is proven (Phase 0B/0C).
